task_description: Run a linter on a source file.
Switch the power profile to one of: performance, balanced, saver.
Compress a folder into a tar.gz archive.
Run a database migration for an environment name (dev, staging, prod).
Show the system journal since a given date.
Check whether a port is open on a host with a network tool.
Build a list of command-line flags from a settings dictionary.
Download a file from a URL with curl.
Show the network details of an interface name such as eth0.
Encrypt a file with gpg for a recipient.
